baseline.preservationRule: Do not revert or overwrite pre-existing cinematic text-scene work; merge overlapping README, SKILL and test changes deliberately.

postReviewNormalizations.reason: Remove one trailing-whitespace-only Markdown line break before commit.

comparisonBoundary.licenseBoundary: Clean-room implementation only; do not copy AGPL source code or protected assets.
comparisonBoundary.productBoundary: Kacha remains a deterministic local production kernel; agent/provider breadth is added through governed adapters.

findings.problem: No unified, machine-enforced capability broker with discovery, hard exclusions and explainable ranking.
findings.recommendation: Add a versioned provider registry and deterministic probe/rank/decision contract.

findings.problem: Paid or metered providers do not share one reserve/approve/reconcile ledger.
findings.recommendation: Enforce budget and unknown-cost blocking at the executor boundary.

findings.problem: Reference-video analysis is not a first-class, rights-aware workflow artifact.
findings.recommendation: Produce technical, structural and creative keep/change/do-not-copy handoff artifacts.

findings.problem: Project events, telemetry, jobs, decisions and cost evidence are fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Add a deterministic, read-only production flight recorder and replay.

findings.problem: Current media search is asset-level and does not expose clip diversity, motion evidence or semantic fallback truthfully.
findings.recommendation: Add clip corpus build/search with MMR diversity and explicit retrieval mode.

findings.problem: Series/hero production intent and composition-engine selection are not a first-class decision artifact.
findings.recommendation: Route through capability evidence with hard requirements and recorded alternatives.

findings.problem: High-value workflows are documented as generic paths rather than validated packs.
findings.recommendation: Add versioned workflow packs mapped to existing Kacha stages and gates.

findings.problem: New production capabilities need coherent CLI, README, SKILL and onboarding surfaces.
findings.recommendation: Expose one command family per contract and keep the Studio observer read-only.
